purpose: Broker explicitly granted local TCP ports through per-route Windows AF_UNIX sockets.
behavior: Binds every listener before returning and connects accepted streams only to its configured 127.0.0.1 port with a ten-second connect timeout; client bytes never choose the destination.
Uses noninheritable overlapped sockets and caps active connections at 64 per route.
Copies both directions with shared sockets, passes EOF as a half-close, and shuts both sides on transfer error.
contracts: The launcher lifetime owns broker workers; socket-folder grants are applied by container/mod.rs before start.
dependencies: Windows WinSock AF_UNIX support and std TcpStream I/O; launcher stderr receives broker errors.
failures_or_limits: No idle/transfer deadline is imposed. If broker-pair thread creation fails, the ignored spawn result leaves the active counter incremented; repeated failures can exhaust admission. Raw listener sockets also rely on launcher exit for some error-path cleanup.

purpose: Coordinate temporary read-only guards and missing-name placeholders with a journal and shared holder locks.
behavior: Serializes journal changes with a directory lock, reconciles stale states, and deduplicates aliases within one protect call by file identity.
Existing paths get captured DACLs and read-only profile rights; missing names become protected empty directories, with per-holder locked marker files.
Release drops markers and parent pins; reconciliation restores a state only when no observed holder remains locked, and removes only empty placeholders.
contracts: Joining commands protect their own SID too; ancestor pins are intended to prevent renaming the guarded path out of its write root.
dependencies: acl.rs supplies capture/protect/restore/identity/pin; container/mod.rs brackets launch and invokes recovery.
failures_or_limits: Protection happens before the state write, leaving a crash interval without a journal record. Ancestor pin errors are ignored. Reconciliation ignores restore/read failures and then removes state; marker-open or non-lock-violation errors count as no live holder. Atomic rename is not a durability flush.
inference: The source comment claims crash safety, but these error/order paths do not establish recovery for every interrupted or failed restore.

purpose: Run the standalone Windows AppContainer launcher and manage grant, broker and guard lifecycle.
behavior: Parses bounded profile names, absolute grant/route/guard/journal paths, isolated toolchain-grant mode, revoke and recovery modes, or app plus verbatim line launch.
Derives the shared toolchain capability, applies profile grants including broker socket folders, starts routes, protects guards and launches with SECURITY_CAPABILITIES plus a new kill-on-close Job.
Inherits only selected standard handles, waits for the confined root, terminates its Job and polls emptiness up to 200 times at 25 ms before releasing guards and cleaning route names.
Toolchain grants are best effort; launcher errors print one diagnostic and exit 125.
contracts: The managed launcher is itself the host child; confined descendants belong to the nested Job and root exit code is returned.
dependencies: acl.rs supplies grants/SIDs; broker.rs fixed endpoints; guard.rs recovery; job.rs and create::Attributes build confinement attributes.
failures_or_limits: App and line are not included in the absolute-path check. Guard release errors are ignored; an unknown active count or the bounded poll expiry permits restoration to continue without confirmed Job emptiness. OS isolation was not executed here.

purpose: Check AppContainer launch argument grammar for grants, routes, profile names and exclusive toolchain mode.
behavior: Builds a read/write grant request with route 5432 and an app command line, asserting parsed profile, grant count, route count/port and verbatim line.
Rejects relative grant/toolchain paths, mixed toolchain/command or revoke modes, zero or malformed ports, invalid or overlong names, missing commands and unknown flags.
Accepts a standalone toolchain request and a read-grant revoke request.
contracts: Parser tests require no confined process creation; they constrain CLI shape only.
dependencies: container/mod.rs parse function and Request fields.
failures_or_limits: The cases do not cover guard/recover journaling, DACL effects, broker networking, or token isolation. Their assertions were not executed.

purpose: Create Windows roots atomically in their Job with a narrow inherited-handle or pseudoconsole attribute list.
behavior: Builds JOB_LIST plus HANDLE_LIST for pipe roots or PSEUDOCONSOLE for terminals; pipe standard handles become inheritable and duplicates are removed from the list.
Always sets STARTF_USESTDHANDLES, leaving explicit null handles for terminals; pipe roots use CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP while terminal roots keep the console group for Ctrl-C.
Passes explicit executable, mutable command line, Unicode environment and cwd to CreateProcessW and owns returned process/thread handles.
An aligned Attributes buffer queries required size, retains caller pointers until deletion, and propagates initialize/update errors.
contracts: Attribute values must remain valid and unmoved until the list drops; Job assignment occurs in process creation rather than after a runnable child exists.
dependencies: spawn.rs supplies validated strings and Stdio; job.rs supplies the Job; pty_windows supplies HPCON.
failures_or_limits: NUL/double-NUL encoding invariants are caller responsibilities. Handle inheritance flags are set here and not reset here; lifetime cleanup relies on owned Stdio supplied by spawn.
